---
title: "Problem Set 1: Scoring, Complexity, and k-mers"
---

## Draft Role

This assignment is the ramp-up problem set. It checks whether students can translate simple sequence assumptions into scores, reason about growth rates, and write a small k-mer counter.

## Planned Sections

1. Log-odds scoring from toy counts.
2. Complexity comparison for simple string algorithms.
3. k-mer counting implementation.
4. Verification on hand-checkable inputs.
5. Failure-mode reflection on what k-mers ignore.
6. AI/tool disclosure.
